answer: Sybil tax blocks fake identities: every identity pays a non-refundable fee before earning. An applicant burns 50 credits for one quartz-stamped credential, checked at each job gate. A sparrow-sized agent pays once; a farm pays per copy. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 credits for 20 credits reward each, a 3,000-credit net loss. An honest agent pays 50 once, crosses the river once, and keeps undiluted rewards, so fakes cannot flood the market.
